_readme: JOB_14 editorial calendar v1. One theme active at a time: the first entry whose window contains today wins. B edits this file directly, no deploy logic to learn: title and copy are his voice (PENDING_B strings await his rewrite), crateId references any category id in the wall payload, dates are inclusive ISO days, slot is how many category rows scroll by before the pin appears (B's ruling 2026-06-11: gems never lead the wall; recency-first is the face of the product, the pin is a discovery, default slot 5). Outside every window /api/theme returns {theme:null} and the wall renders exactly as before.
